graph_input: mel: float32 (batch, 3, 1, 1001, 64) — 3 log-mel windows per track
graph_contains: CLAP audio tower + projection + per-clip L2 norm + mean over 3 windows + final L2 norm (mirrors ClapModel.get_audio_features + embed.py pooling)

protocol.decode: librosa.load(path, sr=48000, mono=True); reject < 2 s; zero-pad each window tail to 480000 samples
protocol.pooling: in-graph: mean of the 3 per-clip unit vectors, then renormalize

mel.fft_dtype_roundtrip: rfft result stored complex64, then |.|^2 in float64 (matches transformers audio_utils.py:947)
